name: C1 · 펼친 내용
run: const e = __e2e.$('.found .evidence.is-open'); return e ? { where: e.querySelector('.evidence__where')?.textContent, quote: e.querySelector('.evidence__quote')?.textContent, match: e.querySelector('.evidence__match')?.textContent } : null;

name: C2 · 첫 행동과 근거
run: const e = __e2e.$('.made .evidence.is-open'); return { step: __e2e.$('.result__title')?.textContent, where: e?.querySelector('.evidence__where')?.textContent, quote: e?.querySelector('.evidence__quote')?.textContent, match: e?.querySelector('.evidence__match')?.textContent, actions: [...(e?.querySelectorAll('.evidence__actions button') ?? [])].map(b => b.textContent) };

name: Leave this out → 다시 빚기
run: __e2e.click(__e2e.byText('Leave this out')); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); return true;

name: 다시 빚은 결과
run: return { step: __e2e.$('.result__title')?.textContent, from: __e2e.all('.made .made__label').map(l => l.textContent), hint: __e2e.$('.result__hint')?.textContent ?? null };
